assertions.name: irreducible_counts
assertions.source: Groebner over QQ with the non-zero condition

description: Counts irreducible boundary-parabolic PSL(2,C) representations of 4_1, 5_2 and 6_1 by Groebner basis over QQ on SnapPy's Ptolemy variety, imposing SnapPy's own non-zero condition. Closes the 6_1 residual that dt_crossknot_connection_count_certified_probe.py left open for want of bundled Magma data or ptolemy-DB egress: 6_1 = 4 irreducible + 1 abelian = 5 connections. Gated on reproducing the certified 4_1 = 2 and 5_2 = 3, and on the three trace-field discriminants -3 / -23 / 257. Records that dropping the non-zero condition yields a spurious zero-coordinate point and the wrong answer 5 irreducible. Supplies R1's INPUT, not a test of R1. Scope-(a); nothing wired. Beans qou-btvl/qou-rtec/qou-dr8m.

method.variety: snappy Manifold.ptolemy_variety(2, 'all'), built OFFLINE — only retrieve_solutions() needs the network
method.solver: sympy Groebner basis over QQ, lex with the Rabinowitsch variable t eliminated first
method.non_zero_condition: snappy's own equations_with_non_zero_condition (1 = c_1 c_2 c_3 c_4 t)
method.abelian_convention: +1 abelian connection = the (L-1) factor of the full A-polynomial; the audit's convention, carried over unchanged, not new derivation

scope.supplies: R1's INPUT — DT_max = #connections makes R1's 6_1 prediction the definite {5}
scope.does_not: test R1. The third-knot test still needs an independent resurgence/Borel DT count for 6_1, absent from the corpus
scope.now_discriminating: R1 -> {5} vs Wedderburn-at-braid-index -> {5,10}, the latter definite only because braid index(6_1) = 4 is now derived (qou-dr8m)

q0AnchorReason: Reads no q0, on either layer. The computation is exact rational algebraic geometry on a Ptolemy variety — a Groebner basis over QQ — and no substrate quantity enters at any point.
